definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of adding numbers together.

examples.japanese: {足|た}し{算|ざん}の{練習|れんしゅう}をする。
この{問題|もんだい}は{足|た}し{算|ざん}で{解|と}ける。
examples.english: This problem can be solved with addition.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{足|た}し{算|ざん}を{教|おし}える。

notes:
{足|た}し{算|ざん} is composed of {足|た}す (to add) + {算|さん} (calculation).

FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS:
- {足|た}し{算|ざん}: addition (+)
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}: subtraction (-)
- {掛|か}け{算|ざん}: multiplication (×)
- {割|わ}り{算|ざん}: division (÷)
